narrative: This batch is a re-pull pass over the agentic SDLC factory toolchain and the generative-UI ecosystem, tightening source-backed facts and surfacing new integration surfaces. The factory pages gain concrete protocol and tooling details — Pi SDK's RPC mode for non-JS integrations, Pierre's v1.3.5 edit-performance fix, gh-aw's technical-preview status with Microsoft Research/Azure Core Upstream, and OpenWiki's v0.3.3 release with OKF v0.2 output — while the generative-UI pages record open demand signals (CopilotKit issues #2186 and #1993) that show where the AG-UI/CopilotKit/Mastra coupling is still maturing. Across both clusters, the theme is the same: the ecosystem is converging on a few wire protocols (ACP, AG-UI, A2UI) and the wiki is tracking the community and issue-tracker evidence that reveals where those protocols are still incomplete or contested.

entries.title: Agentic SDLC factory toolchain
entries.summary: Updated the factory toolchain concept with new source-backed details: Pi SDK now documents an RPC mode (`pi --mode rpc`, LF-delimited JSONL) for non-JS integrations, and gh-aw is confirmed in technical preview as a GitHub/Microsoft Research/Azure Core Upstream collaboration. Also added watchlist signals from Zed's sandboxing post and re-surfaced DeltaDB, plus the gh-aw-mcpg MCP gateway.

entries.title: Generative-UI ecosystem
entries.summary: Added two open CopilotKit issues (#2186 for direct AG-UI-to-CopilotKit integration without the Runtime, #1993 for agentic generative UI + shared state through Mastra) as watchlist evidence of demand for tighter AG-UI/CopilotKit/Mastra coupling.

entries.title: Agent Client Protocol (ACP)

Also re-confirmed first-party servers codex-acp and claude-agent-acp.

entries.title: MCP Apps (Model Context Protocol Apps extension)
entries.summary: MCP Apps is the first official extension to the Model Context Protocol, co-developed by Anthropic and OpenAI, letting MCP servers deliver interactive UIs (charts, forms, dashboards) rendered securely in sandboxed iframes inside any compliant host — with a 5-phase UI lifecycle, ui:// tool-linked resources, JSON-RPC-over-postMessage communication, tool visibility, host theming/context, and display modes.

entries.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entries.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the open standard for how AI agents integrate with external tools, data sources, and other agents — JSON-RPC 2.0-based tools, resources, and prompts with capability negotiation, sampling, elicitation, authorization, and a 2026-07-28 revision that made the core stateless, added Multi Round-Trip Requests, header-based routing, cacheable list results, full JSON Schema 2020-12 for tool schemas, and a formal extensions framework and lifecycle policy.

entries.title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
entries.summary: OKF is a minimal, vendor-neutral format for representing knowledge as markdown files with YAML frontmatter in a self-describing bundle — standardizing the small set of structural conventions (required type, provenance, trust, lifecycle, attestation) that make an agent-maintained knowledge corpus trustable.

entries.title: AI Knowledge Wiki Quickstart
entries.summary: Navigation and current status for the AI knowledge corpus — the Model Context Protocol (MCP) core and its 2026-07-28 stateless revision (revision, SDK posture, registry, extensions, and MCP Apps interface surface refreshed 2026-08-22), the Agent Host Protocol (AHP), Agent Client Protocol (ACP), the generative-UI / agent-UI protocol ecosystem (with the AG-UI Kotlin SDK and Cedar-OS deltas), the agentic SDLC factory toolchain (Pierre, t3code, Effect, OpenCode, Pi SDK, gh-aw CI workflows, and the followed blog feeds), and the agent-maintained knowledge-base layer (the Open Knowledge Format v0.2 spec and its growing producer/consumer ecosystem — okc, erd2okf, okf-gem/okf-mcp, AKB, openknowledge, okf-ingest — plus the OpenWiki CLI, 12+ model providers, OKF v0.2 output, v0.3.3 latest, that maintains this wiki).

entries.title: Model Context Protocol releases
entries.summary: Versioned revision history of the Model Context Protocol specification and Tier 1 SDK posture — revisions 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25 (RC 2025-11-15), and the current stateless 2026-07-28 revision, plus the Java SDK v2.0.0 GA (tracking 2025-11-25), the TypeScript SDK v2.0.0 monorepo split, beta SDK versions for Go and C#, and companion-repo release trails (servers, swift-sdk, mcpb, registry).

entries.title: Recurring themes and trends
entries.summary: Compact index of recurring signals across the AI knowledge corpus — standardization and convergence of generative-UI / agent-UI protocols in 2026, MCP core standardization toward production infrastructure (stateless 2026-07-28 core, extensions framework, DCR→CIMD), the emerging agentic SDLC factory toolchain (including its CI-native gh-aw layer), and the emergence of agent-maintained knowledge-base formats and tooling (OKF v0.2, OpenWiki v0.3.3).
